_readme: UAE market pack, the LIVE ruleset the engine reads. It starts as an exact copy of policy-rules.v1.0.json (the locked reference). Edit THIS file to change policy: the plug and play demo changes dbr_cap here from 0.5 to 0.45 and reruns. Placeholders like {dbr_cap_pct} in rule_text are rendered from the parameters block, so the cited sentence and the enforced number can never disagree. Adding a rule entry needs a matching check implementation in src/lib/policy.ts (the engine refuses to run a rule it has no semantics for, no silent skips).

_notes.product_min_salary: product assumption, stated in the ground truth
_notes.flat_annual_rate: used ONLY to estimate the monthly installment for the DBR check (rule 2); product assumption locked with the ground truth
_notes.dbr_cap: UAE-standard cap, flagged in the ground truth for primary-sourcing: total repayments may not exceed half of income
_notes.amount_salary_multiple: UAE-standard cap: a personal loan may not exceed 20 times monthly salary
_notes.max_age_at_maturity: the borrower must be 65 or younger when the last installment falls due (rule 3)
_notes.min_tenure_months: minimum months in the current job (rule 4); matches one full probation period
_notes.personal_loan_max_term_months: 48-month personal loan term cap (Phase 3 primary-sourcing); Step 5 form validation enforces it

band_cutoffs._note: decision M3: numeric points mapped to bands; the cut-offs are Phase 3's call. 70+ means strong on at least four of the five factors, the profile a conservative v1 (D6) can recommend approving. Under 45 means weakness is the pattern, not the exception. The middle goes to a human (D8).

rules.title: Minimum salary for the product
rules.rule_text: Applicants must earn at least the minimum monthly salary set for the product applied for.

rules.title: Debt burden ratio cap
rules.rule_text: Total monthly debt obligations including the new installment must not exceed {dbr_cap_pct} percent of monthly salary.

rules.title: Maximum age at loan maturity
rules.rule_text: The applicant must be no older than {max_age_at_maturity} at the end of the loan term.

rules.title: Minimum employment tenure
rules.rule_text: Applicants must show {min_tenure_months} months of continuous employment.

rules.title: Valid residency for the loan term
rules.rule_text: The applicant's residency visa must remain valid for the full loan term.

rules.title: Maximum loan amount as a multiple of salary
rules.rule_text: The requested amount must not exceed {amount_salary_multiple} times the applicant's monthly salary.

scorecard._note: M5 guardrail, moved here with the values: every tier below is set from the domain rationale written next to it, never from the ground-truth labels. Changing a tier requires a rationale that stands on its own. Factor semantics live in code (src/lib/scorecard.ts FACTOR_IMPLS) keyed by factor_id; points, tiers, names, and rationales live here. Each factor awards 0 to 20 points (decision M3); the screens render one row per enabled factor. Tier tables are ordered descending and end with a catch-all at 0.

factors._rationale: capacity is about headroom over the product minimum, not the absolute number. Double the minimum is a strong cushion; at the minimum the applicant passes policy but has no buffer for shocks, which matters more for a newcomer with no local safety net.

ratio_tiers.rationale: salary is at least double the product minimum, strong repayment cushion
salary is well above the product minimum
salary is moderately above the product minimum
salary meets the product minimum with little headroom
salary is below the product minimum

factors.threshold_label: tiers at 3, 6 and 12 months; self-employed capped
factors._rationale: 6 months tenure matches the policy threshold (one full probation period); 12 months is a completed review cycle. Self-employment is capped lower not because the income is worse but because v1 cannot verify drawings the way it can a salary letter.

self_employed_tiers.rationale: established self-employment, but income is harder to verify than a salary
self-employed past probation length, income verification still limited
young self-employment with limited verifiable income history

employed_tiers.rationale: a full year in the current job, stable income
tenure under 6 months, stability not yet confirmed
very short tenure, income stability unproven

factors.threshold_label: tiered: government > mainland > free zone > SME > other
factors._rationale: standard UAE underwriting tiers. Government employment is the most stable; SME and uncategorized employers carry the most income-continuity risk.

free_zone.rationale: free zone employer, mid stability tier

factors.threshold_label: tiers at 3, 6 and 12 months, plus long-term visa bonus
factors._rationale: time in country builds a verifiable footprint (address, banking, employer record). A long-term visa (golden, green) reduces the leave-the-country risk that drives newcomer defaults, so it earns a bonus on top.

month_tiers.rationale: a full year in the UAE, established local footprint
recent arrival, little local footprint yet
recent arrival, little local footprint yet

factors.long_term_bonus_rationale: long-term visa materially lowers departure risk

factors.threshold_label: on time 6+ months is full points; late payments is zero
factors._rationale: rent is the behavioral anchor, the alt-data standing in for the missing credit file. Sustained on-time payment is the strongest available repayment evidence; late payments are adverse evidence, worse than no history at all.

on_time_6plus.rationale: 6+ months of on-time rent, the strongest available behavioral evidence

on_time_under_6.rationale: on-time so far, but the record is shorter than 6 months

none.rationale: no rent history available, behavioral evidence missing

late_payments.rationale: late rent payments, adverse behavioral evidence
